    "Custom reporting can be complex to set up and extract specific data",
    "Some limitations in advanced customization for payroll monitoring",
    "Occasional slowness or multiple clicks required for certain functions"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Club Accountant found Paylocity to be a generally capable system for managing timecards and payroll within a mid-market company. While the platform offered a good overview and employee self-service features, the custom reporting capabilities, crucial for their role, proved to be less straightforward and sometimes limited. This led to a slightly less efficient workflow for detailed monitoring, despite the overall positive aspects of the system's ease of use for standard operations."
